name: Azure Boards
description: Your Azure Boards work items (Azure DevOps Services) in Orca: what is assigned to you and your team's board. Search, move items between states and columns, and start work on one with a coding agent.

settings.title: Organization
settings.description: The name in https://dev.azure.com/<organization>. You can paste the URL instead.

settings.title: Group work items by
settings.description: How the panel groups the list. You can also change it from the panel.

settings.title: Remove the area prefix from titles
settings.description: Hides a leading [Team or area name] in titles when it matches the item's area path.

settings.title: Refresh every
settings.description: Reloads the list while the panel is visible. Off reloads only when you press Refresh.

settings.title: Hidden states
settings.description: Comma-separated work item states left out of the list.
